ba9c464a9fa5f9b78f5379e6d7938d2c506a18bb.baseline: First synchronized completed M1 close at/after saved delivery, within 120 seconds.
ba9c464a9fa5f9b78f5379e6d7938d2c506a18bb.primary_end: Earliest explicit evaluation end, precise checkpoint or superseding delivered assessment.
ba9c464a9fa5f9b78f5379e6d7938d2c506a18bb.legacy_window: Without an explicit evaluation end, checkpoint/supersession windows are diagnostic proxies.
ba9c464a9fa5f9b78f5379e6d7938d2c506a18bb.basket: Geometric equal-weight return against the other seven currencies, triangulated from seven USD legs.
ba9c464a9fa5f9b78f5379e6d7938d2c506a18bb.path: Synchronized minute closes only; excursions are sampled, not intraminute extrema or executable profit.
ba9c464a9fa5f9b78f5379e6d7938d2c506a18bb.coverage: Exact completed endpoints; no filling gaps. Incomplete paths excluded from complete-path statistics.
ba9c464a9fa5f9b78f5379e6d7938d2c506a18bb.independence: Declarations, currencies and crosses are correlated; report currency-day aggregates separately.
ba9c464a9fa5f9b78f5379e6d7938d2c506a18bb.flat: Zero terminal return is flat, not a correct direction.
ba9c464a9fa5f9b78f5379e6d7938d2c506a18bb.eligibility: Live standalone complete/provisional calls only; exclude reconstruction, obsolete corrections and missing horizons.
ba9c464a9fa5f9b78f5379e6d7938d2c506a18bb.limitations: No spreads, fills, financing, trading profits, flow attribution or causal proof. Basket is a relative FX proxy.

benchmark_limitation: Previous eligible direction is evaluated on the identical current interval, without extending its original validity. This naive persistence comparison is correlated and descriptive, not an executable strategy.

daily_excursions.protocol: Post-delivery sampled maximum excursion through broker-day close; active-window feedback and daily-open context stay separate.
daily_excursions.interpretation: Aligned observed excursion is a supporting/reward case; opposed excursion is a refinement candidate. Coverage remains explicit, including partial paths. Day-open context never credits a late call. Review original reasoning and contrary facts; neither causality nor profitability is proved.
